apps/web/components/features/profile/art.loading: Loading is the InlineNotificationsFlowSkeleton, chosen by hydrationStatus from useSubscriptionForm; it has its own stories and the unit test covers it.
apps/web/components/features/profile/art.empty: The CTA takes no collection; the detector matched an empty-looking default. The no-alerts case renders null and is covered by the unit test.
apps/web/components/features/profile/art.error: Submission errors are rendered by ProfileMobileNotificationsFlow, which has its own Error stories; this component only passes the error string down.
apps/web/components/features/profile/art.offline: The CTA makes no network request itself; submissions and offline handling live in useSubscriptionForm.
